name: Web Freelancers Product Weight Shipping for WooCommerce
author: webfreelancers

sections.description:
Web Freelancers Product Weight Shipping is a WooCommerce shipping utility developed by Web Freelancers, a web development company providing WordPress and WooCommerce website development services.

The plugin is designed to help WooCommerce store administrators configure group-based shipping rules based on product weight, with state and region filtering.

Use the plugin’s settings in your WordPress dashboard to manage the shipping groups and rules available in your installed version.

For information about Web Freelancers and its WordPress and WooCommerce development services, visit:
https://webfreelancers.in/

Features

  • Group-based product weight shipping rules.
  • State and region filtering for shipping rules.
  • WooCommerce integration.

Requirements

  • WordPress.
  • WooCommerce installed and activated.
  • A hosting environment that meets the requirements of your installed WordPress and WooCommerce versions.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin.
  2. Select the plugin ZIP file and click Install Now.
  3. Activate Web Freelancers Product Weight Shipping for WooCommerce.
  4. Confirm that WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  5. Open the plugin’s settings and configure your shipping groups and rules.
  6. Test the checkout process with suitable products and delivery addresses before using the rules on a live store.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

What does the plugin help configure?

It provides group-based product weight shipping rules with state and region filtering. The exact options depend on the installed plugin version.

Where can I get help with Web Freelancers services?

Visit https://webfreelancers.in/ for information about Web Freelancers and its WordPress and WooCommerce development services.
